name: Frost on the cabinet
notes: Played by FS47Attention (S47Attention.cpp, N1110) with a relay fault on the array (FS47FreeformWorld::TriggerServiceFault): its repair is the usual one. Point: cabinet. Two more ceiling tubes go out in the control room (tube beat, next 2).

beats.text: PRINTER / REMOTE LINK LOST. JUNCTION CABINET TEMP 28 F.
Twenty-eight degrees in there. On a warm night.
At {clock} one antenna dropped its remote link, and the rack printer logged its junction cabinet at 28 degrees on a warm night. There was frost on the cabinet door.
Two of the ceiling tubes just died. The Caliche shop counter sells them in pairs.
